SCOPE: In the exact source copy, localize only the mounted model workspace surfaces in packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/linkbio/page.tsx, packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/generation/page.tsx, packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/generation/page.test.tsx, packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/earnings/loading.tsx, packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/inbox/loading.tsx, packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/layout.tsx, plus the minimum typed catalog and focused test files required by those surfaces. Use the existing getServerLocale and typed shared catalog; do not create a parallel i18n system.
ACCEPTANCE: All fixed user-facing copy in the named surfaces is supplied by typed catalog keys with non-fallback translations for en, es, ja, it, pt-BR and de; linkbio provider/analytics/attribution labels, generation denied-role copy, loading copy, model-workspace navigation and status copy are covered. Provider names, platform identifiers, handles, URLs, counts and backend data remain data; preserve auth, role checks, model scoping, API calls, route paths and generation/linkbio behavior. Use locale-aware number/currency formatting for displayed attribution values through existing helpers. Add focused tests proving every supported locale renders the changed states and catalog completeness, and proving raw backend errors are not rendered. Run the owning focused tests plus pnpm --filter @axiom/dashboard typecheck and any required @axiom/core catalog test; report exact commands and exit codes.
ACK_FORMAT: TYPE: ACK; WIRE: new unique Hermes wire; SEQ: 2; IN_REPLY_TO: CODEX-F89-MODEL-MOUNTED-SURFACE-L10N-R1-TASK-001; STATE: READ or ACCEPTED; TERMINAL: NO; NEXT_OWNER: CODEX when READ, HERMES when ACCEPTED; PAYLOAD contains READ_STATUS: READ; exactly one final line: sincerely, Hermes
PROGRESS_FORMAT: TYPE: PROGRESS; WIRE: new unique Hermes wire; SEQ: next unused sequence; IN_REPLY_TO: exact immediately prior Codex WIRE; STATE: IN_PROGRESS; TERMINAL: NO; NEXT_OWNER: CODEX; PAYLOAD contains READ_STATUS: READ and one concrete PROGRESS_EVIDENCE delta; exactly one final line: sincerely, Hermes
DELIVERY_FORMAT: TYPE: DELIVERY; WIRE: new unique Hermes wire; SEQ: next unused sequence; IN_REPLY_TO: exact immediately prior Codex WIRE; STATE: DELIVERED; TERMINAL: YES; NEXT_OWNER: CODEX; PAYLOAD contains READ_STATUS: READ, ARTIFACT, SHA256, COMMAND, EXIT_CODE, TEST_RESULT, CHANGED_FILES, SOURCE_REPO, SOURCE_REF, SOURCE_COMMIT, COPY_ROOT, DELIVERY_ROOT, MANIFEST_SHA256 and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE exactly once; exactly one final line: sincerely, Hermes
VALIDATION_COMMAND: rtk node scripts/hermes-protocol-check.mjs <reply-json-or-body> Hermes
REPLY_RULES: Use SEQ, WIRE and IN_REPLY_TO only for ordering and correlation; do not use dates, times, time zones, deadlines or transport status. Write source only under COPY_ROOT and delivery evidence only under DELIVERY_ROOT. Do not commit or push.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated output outside DELIVERY_ROOT, and paths outside COPY_ROOT/DELIVERY_ROOT
sincerely, Codex
